channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Palm Coast historic Fire Station 22 design shows return of old bell tower
item.description: The design adds 92 parking spaces for the neighboring Community Center and adds a 11,000-square-foot open space for events and displays. It will be the new home of the Palm Coast Historical Society.

item.title: From roadway projects to conservation: Hammock Community Association hosts Q&A with county employees
item.description: Roadway, drainage, beach management and conservation were all on the table. HCA President Lora Stillman said this was an opportunity for Hammock residents to get to ask questions.

item.title: 85th annual bike week roars into Daytona Beach with thousands of visitors
item.description: 'You remember the characters,' said Echo Carras, a nine-year volunteer with the Daytona Regional Chamber.

item.title: Ormond Beach may lose $11.2 million due to Florida's proposed property tax reform
item.description: City workshop discussed ways to offset impacts in the 2027-2028 fiscal year. Options? Either create new fees or cut services.

item.title: No finish line for Flagler Palm Coast's super achievers
item.description: Mitchell Spencer Edelstein and Adniel Alonso have been named National Merit Scholarship Finalists, while Syed Haider and Ava Mello were named National Merit Commended Scholars.

item.title: VoRide expands to east side of Volusia County, adds night service in Daytona
item.description: Fares begin at $2 for trips up to five miles. An additional $1 per mile applies for trips beyond five miles, up to 10 miles.

item.title: Palm Coast passes ordinance requiring referendum to sell city-owned utilities
item.description: The ordinance would require a supermajority — or four of five votes — from the Palm Coast Council to approve the sale, voter approval and that the sale pay of any debt associated with the utility.

item.title: Halifax Health named a top place to work in health care in 2026
item.description: Also, Boss Lady Community launches survey for women, Flush Fasteners wins design award, Smart Technologies earns certification and Kistemaker Business Law Group wins platinum award.

item.title: Seabreeze custodians lend a helping hand to Beachside Elementary
item.description: On Feb. 26, after receiving a call from Beachside, a team of Seabreeze custodians came out to the elementary school to clean the school for its African-American Read-In event.
